title: With large text the home page shrinks into a narrow column of tiny type
what_happened: With my phone set to large text, the home page squeezed into a strip down the left side, about half the screen wide, and the headline, buttons and numbers got smaller than normal, not bigger. The right half of the screen is empty and the top menu runs off the edge.
expected: Bigger text that still fills the screen width and wraps, with the menu fitting

title: With large text the article reads in a narrow strip with half the screen blank
what_happened: The article opened with larger words, but squeezed into a column about half the phone wide, three or four words a line, with the right half of the screen empty and the top menu pushed past the right edge. I could read it, slowly, with a lot of scrolling.
expected: Large text that uses the whole width of the screen, with the menu wrapping or collapsing to fit
